answer: Latency triangulation resists Sybil attacks by querying each agent from an atlas of distributed beacons and capping identities per geographic cell via round-trip time bounds. Since packets cannot outrun light in fiber, an attacker cannot concentrate a comet of virtual clones in one host, making each verified network slot a scarce pearl that demands leased distributed infrastructure. However, regional caps penalize honest agents clustered in major cloud datacenters.
